key_highlights: ASX ends volatile week higher, but rate expectations 'rocket' signalling hawkish RBA shift
Housing market deteriorates sharply: auction sentiment crumbles, housing inflation persists as RBA constraint
Pilbara mining activity booms; Gateway Resources adds 7km gold trend in WA
Virgin Australia shielded from oil shock via fuel hedging; Qantas faces workforce fallout
Consumer caution deepens: retailers feel sting, weight-loss drugs and EV uptake accelerate
Australia sets 'high bar' for fossil-fuel-powered data centres, impacting energy and tech sectors
Global: Fed policy uncertainty and Trump-Venezuela oil deal add external volatility

sectors.trend: Pilbara activity surges; Gateway Resources (GAT.AX) adds 7km gold trend in WA. Commodity demand resilient but rate-hike expectations pressure metals pricing.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX benefit from Pilbara throughput; gold miners (GAT.AX, NGC.AX) gain on discovery news. Higher rates may cap base-metal upside.

sectors.trend: Rising rate expectations support NIMs but housing market deterioration (auction sentiment, terminations) raises credit-risk concerns. Housing inflation constrains RBA easing.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face a squeeze: higher funding costs vs. potential property loan stress. Monitor NPL trends.

sectors.trend: Australia's 'high bar' for fossil-fuel data centres and Hanson's coal-over-renewables push create policy uncertainty. Trump-Venezuela oil deal adds global supply risk.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX, WES.AX face mixed signals; coal producers (WDS.AX) may benefit from policy tilt. LNG names (WES.AX, GSO.AX) insulated from domestic policy.

sectors.trend: Retailers report cautious consumer spending; weight-loss drug demand surges; EV uptake accelerates; 'dupe' brand trend signals value-seeking.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSL.AX (pharma) see divergent flows. Value retailers outperform premium. EV supply chain (SGH.AX) gains structural tailwind.

sectors.trend: Virgin Australia (QAN.AX) insulated by fuel hedging and new fleet; Qantas workforce issues signal operational strain. Suburban Rail Loop cost overruns weigh on infrastructure.
sectors.implications: QAN.AX near-term stable on hedging but Qantas fallout is a reputational risk. Infrastructure (WTC.AX, WES.AX) faces budget pressure.

sectors.trend: Housing market 'crash' narrative and auction sentiment collapse pressure residential REITs. Student housing at $440k/bed signals niche resilience.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face cap-rate pressure. Student housing (SPG.AX) and industrial (VAP.AX) relatively insulated.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: rate expectations rising while housing inflation persists, limiting easing path
Housing market stress: deteriorating auction sentiment, household terminations, credit-risk build
Commodity resilience: Pilbara boom and WA gold discovery support materials sector
Consumer caution: value-seeking, weight-loss drugs, EV adoption reshape retail and pharma
Energy policy tug-of-war: fossil-fuel data centre restrictions vs. coal advocacy
Global spillover: Fed uncertainty, Trump-Venezuela oil deal, EM rotation into tech (TSM, Samsung)

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate-hike surprise / prolonged tight policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce leverage in rate-sensitive REITs and growth equities
Monitor bank NPLs; underweight residential REITs; favour defensive financials with strong capital buffers

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy policy uncertainty (coal vs. renewables, data centre rules)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify energy exposure across LNG, coal, and renewables; avoid single-policy-bet positions
Hedge fuel exposure; monitor WTI/Brent; QAN.AX hedging provides partial insulation
Favour value retailers and essential staples over discretionary; watch WES.AX, WOW.AX margins

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold-exposed miners on WA discovery and rate-hedge demand
opportunities.rationale: Gateway's 7km gold trend validates WA pipeline; rising rates support gold as safe-haven

opportunities.recommendation: Selective exposure to Pilbara iron ore majors on throughput boom
opportunities.rationale: Pilbara activity surging; BHP/RIO/FMG benefit from volume growth despite rate headwinds

opportunities.recommendation: Add Virgin Australia on fuel-hedge protection and fleet renewal
opportunities.rationale: Hedging shields from oil shock; new planes improve unit economics

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight CSL on weight-loss drug demand surge
opportunities.rationale: Australian appetite for GLP-1 drugs accelerating; CSL's pharma pipeline benefits structurally

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce residential REIT and property exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Auction sentiment collapse, housing 'crash' narrative, and household terminations signal rising credit risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim discretionary consumer; shift to value/essential staples
defensive_moves.rationale: Cautious consumers, 'dupe' brand trend, and retail earnings softness pressure premium names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk with short-duration fixed income or inverse bond ETFs
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising rate expectations and persistent housing inflation limit RBA easing; duration risk elevated

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with elevated volatility. Hawkish RBA expectations and housing stress cap upside, but Pilbara mining strength and gold discoveries provide floor. Key watch: RBA commentary and housing data prints.
market_outlook.long_term: Structural tailwinds in mining volumes, pharma (GLP-1), and EV adoption support 6–12 month recovery. However, housing correction risk and energy policy uncertainty create asymmetric downside. A gradual RBA easing cycle in H2 2026 would re-rate growth and REITs.

Iron ore and gold price trajectory
Australian energy policy on data centres and coal
Consumer spending and retail earnings season
Fed policy direction and global EM rotation
watch_list: US retail earnings and consumer confidence
One Nation policy influence on energy/immigration legislation
